🚀 HeroQuest Card Creator - v0.6.2 Is Live

Version 0.6.2 keeps the project moving quickly after Decks, bringing a stronger card-authoring experience and making the app feel more expressive without losing momentum.

Updates / 🚀 HeroQuest Card Creator - v0.6.2 Is Live

Announcement • 22 June 2026

Read the full update on Itch Open the app on Itch

Version 0.6.2 keeps the project moving quickly after Decks, bringing a stronger card-authoring experience and making the app feel more expressive without losing momentum.

The release gathers together improvements that make writing and shaping cards feel more flexible, while still tightening the everyday workflow underneath. It sits in an important place between the Decks release and the later PDF milestone, showing the app becoming more comfortable and more capable at the same time.
